isBasedOn.name: BioCyc Database
isBasedOn.description: BioCyc is a collection of 20,043 Pathway/Genome Databases (PGDBs) for model eukaryotes and for thousands of microbes, plus software tools for exploring them.

isBasedOn.name: BioGRID Database
isBasedOn.description: Biological General Repository for Interaction Datasets.

creator.name: Institut de Recherche en Immunologie et en Cancérologie, Lewis-Sigler Institute for Integrative Genomics, Lunenfeld-Tanenbaum Research Institute

isBasedOn.name: COG Database
isBasedOn.description: COGs stands for Clusters of Orthologous Genes. The database was initially created in 1997 (Tatusov et al., PMID: 9381173) followed by several updates, most recently in 2014 (Galperin et al., PMID: 25428365).

isBasedOn.name: COMPARTMENTS Database
isBasedOn.description: COMPARTMENTS is a database of protein subcellular localization evidence, using evidence collected by integrating experimental datasets, by integrating sequence-based predictions, by manual literature curation, or by automated textmining.

creator.name: Novo Nordisk Foundation Center for Protein Research

isBasedOn.name: DIP Database
isBasedOn.description: The Database of Interacting Proteins (DIP) is a biological database which catalogs experimentally determined protein-protein interactions.

creator.name: Howard Hughes Medical Institute, 2UCLA-DOE Institute for Genomics and Proteomics, 3Department of Chemistry and Biochemistry and 4Department of Biological Chemistry, Molecular Biology Institute

isBasedOn.name: DISEASES Database
isBasedOn.description: Diseases Database is a cross-referenced index of human disease, medications, symptoms, signs, and abnormal investigation findings. The content focuses on internal medicine, inherited disease, clinical biochemistry, and pharmacology. Its terms are referred to as items.

creator.name: Novo Nordisk Foundation Center for Protein Research

isBasedOn.name: EggNOG Database
isBasedOn.description: Database of orthology relationships, functional annotation, and gene evolutionary histories.

isBasedOn.name: Ensembl Database
isBasedOn.description: Genome browser for vertebrate genomes that supports research in comparative genomics, evolution, sequence variation and transcriptional regulation.

isBasedOn.name: FlyBase Database
isBasedOn.description: FlyBase is a database of genetic and molecular data concerning Drosophila . FlyBase is maintained as a relational database (in Sybase).

creator.name: Harvard University, University of Cambridge, Indiana University

isBasedOn.name: GEO Database
isBasedOn.description: Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO) is a database repository of high throughput gene expression data and hybridization arrays, chips, microarrays.

isBasedOn.name: Gene Ontology Database
isBasedOn.description: The Gene Ontology (GO) knowledgebase is the world's largest source of information on the functions of genes.

isBasedOn.name: HPRD Database
isBasedOn.description: Human Protein Reference Database (HPRD) is a rich resource of experimentally proven features of human proteins.

creator.name: Institute of Bioinformatics in Bangalore, India and the Pandey lab at Johns Hopkins University in Baltimore, USA.

isBasedOn.name: HUGO Database
isBasedOn.description: HUGO Gene Nomenclature Committee, a resource for approved human gene nomenclature containing ~42000 gene symbols and names and 1300+ gene families and sets.

isBasedOn.name: Intact Database
isBasedOn.description: IntAct Molecular Interaction Database provides a free, open source database system and analysis tools for molecular interaction data.

isBasedOn.name: InterPro Database
isBasedOn.description: InterPro provides functional analysis of proteins by classifying them into families and predicting domains and important sites.

isBasedOn.name: KEGG Database
isBasedOn.description: KEGG (Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes) is a bioinformatics resource for linking genomes to life and the environment.

creator.name: Kanehisa Laboratories at Kyoto University Bioinformatics Center

isBasedOn.name: MINT Database
isBasedOn.description: MINT is a public and open source database focusing on experimentally verified protein-protein interactions mined from the scientific literature by expert curators.

isBasedOn.name: OMIM Database
isBasedOn.description: Online Catalog of Human Genes and Genetic Disorders

isBasedOn.name: PDB Database
isBasedOn.description: RCSB Protein Data Bank (RCSB PDB). As a member of the wwPDB, the RCSB PDB curates and annotates PDB data according to agreed upon standards.

isBasedOn.name: Pfam Database
isBasedOn.description: The Pfam database is a large collection of protein families, each represented by multiple sequence alignments and hidden Markov models (HMMs).

isBasedOn.name: ProteomeHD Database
isBasedOn.description: ProteomeHD is an R script for creating a co-regulation map of the human proteome enables identification of protein functions.

creator.name: Institute of Biotechnology, Department of Bioanalytics, Berlin, Germany

isBasedOn.name: PubMed central Database
isBasedOn.description: PubMed Central (PMC) is a free full-text archive of biomedical and life sciences journal literature at the U.S. National Institutes of Health's National Library of Medicine (NIH/NLM).

isBasedOn.name: Reactome Database
isBasedOn.description: REACTOME is an open-source, open access, manually curated and peer-reviewed pathway database. It's goal is to provide intuitive bioinformatics tools for the visualization, interpretation and analysis of pathway knowledge to support basic and clinical research, genome analysis, modeling, systems biology and education.

isBasedOn.name: RefSeq Database
isBasedOn.description: RefSeq: NCBI Reference Sequence Database, a comprehensive, integrated, non-redundant, well-annotated set of reference sequences including genomic, transcript, and protein.

isBasedOn.name: SGD Database
isBasedOn.description: The Saccharomyces Genome Database (SGD) provides comprehensive integrated biological information for the budding yeast Saccharomyces cerevisiae.

isBasedOn.name: SIMAP Database
isBasedOn.description: The similarity matrix of proteins is a database of protein sequences, their all-against-all sequence similarities and functional annotations. The database is currently re-implemented, based on a different algorithm for sequence similarity calculation.

isBasedOn.name: SMART Database
isBasedOn.description: SMART (a Simple Modular Architecture Research Tool) allows the identification and annotation of genetically mobile domains and the analysis of domain architectures.

isBasedOn.name: SwissModel Database
isBasedOn.description: SWISS-MODEL is a fully automated protein structure homology-modelling server, accessible via the Expasy web server, or from the program DeepView (Swiss Pdb-Viewer).

isBasedOn.name: TISSUES Database
isBasedOn.description: TISSUES is a weekly updated web resource that integrates evidence on tissue expression from manually curated literature, proteomics and transcriptomics screens, and automatic text mining.

creator.name: Novo Nordisk Foundation Center for Protein Research

isBasedOn.name: UniProt Database
isBasedOn.description: UniProt is the world's leading high-quality, comprehensive and freely accessible resource of protein sequence and functional information.

isBasedOn.name: WikiPathways Database
isBasedOn.description: WikiPathways is an open science platform for biological pathways contributed, updated, and used by the research community.

isBasedOn.name: WormBase Database
isBasedOn.description: WormBase: a modern Model Organism Information Resource

isBasedOn.name: proGenomes Database
isBasedOn.description: proGenomes v3 provides over 900,000 consistently annotated bacterial and archaeal genomes containing 4 billion genes from over 40,000 species.
